matches.title: Twente vs Ferencváros
matches.description: Watch Twente vs Ferencváros highlights and goals from UEFA Europa League on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on July 23, 2026. The UEFA Europa League clash between Twente and Ferencváros on July 23, 2026, delivered a captivating display of European football, characterized by tactical discipline and clinical finishing. Both sides entered the arena knowing that momentum in the group stages is hard to win but easy to lose, setting the stage for a fiercely contested battle. Early Breakthrough and Twente’s Response Ferencváros made their intentions clear from the opening whistle, playing with a directness that troubled the hosts. Their early dominance paid dividends in the 14th minute when Kristoffer Zachariassen carved open the defense with a brilliant pass to Lenny Joseph . The forward made no mistake, firing his shot home to give the visitors an early lead. The goal sparked the home crowd into life, and Twente began to monopolize possession in search of a way back into the game. That equalizer eventually arrived in the 38th minute, capping off a period of sustained pressure from the Dutch side. Sondre Oerjasaeter provided a perfectly weighted assist for Aske Adelgaard , who kept his composure to slot the ball into the net. The match remained balanced as the referee blew for half-time, with both teams having everything to play for in the second period. Joseph Seals the Victory The second half saw a series of tactical adjustments as both managers looked to break the deadlock. Twente introduced fresh legs in the form of Mathias Kjoeloe and Younes Taha , while Ferencváros countered by bringing on Callum O'Dowda . It was the latter substitution that proved to be a masterstroke. The game tightened up, with few clear-cut chances until the final ten minutes when the decisive blow was struck. In the 80th minute, Callum O'Dowda turned provider, finding Lenny Joseph in the box with a precise cross. Joseph clinical finish marked his second goal of the night and restored the lead for Ferencváros . Despite a late flurry of activity and deep into four minutes of stoppage time, Twente could not find a second equalizer. The final whistle confirmed a vital away win for the Hungarian champions, leaving the home fans disappointed after a valiant effort.

The atmosphere was electric as Twente hosted Sparta Rotterdam in a high-stakes Eredivisie encounter. On May 10, 2026, a crowd of 29,600 spectators gathered to witness a clash defined by tactical battles and clinical finishing. First half momentum Twente looked the sharper side early on, with Daan Rots consistently delivering dangerous corners that tested the visitor's resolve. The intensity reached its peak at the 35th minute when Thomas van den Belt attempted a sensational bicycle kick that rattled the crossbar. Despite Sparta Rotterdam finding pockets of space through Casper Terho , they were unable to beat Joel Drommel , who handled every aerial threat with composure. The teams went into the break with the deadlock unbroken, but the momentum clearly favored the home side. Second half dominance Following the interval, the pressure finally told. Thomas van den Belt broke the deadlock in the 59th minute, tapping home a precise finish following collaborative play from Bart van Rooij and Daan Rots . With the lead secured, Twente pushed forward with renewed confidence. In the 71st minute, Kristian Hlynsson doubled the advantage with a clinical header, and just seven minutes later, Daan Rots added a third with a left-footed strike. The match concluded on a somber note for the visitors, as Alwande Roaldsoey was forced off with an injury, leaving the side with ten men. Twente closed out the game with 57% possession to seal a deserved victory.

matches.title: AZ Alkmaar vs Twente
matches.description: Watch AZ Alkmaar vs Twente highlights and goals from Eredivisie on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 3, 2026. AZ Alkmaar and Twente faced off in a high-octane Eredivisie encounter that promised tactical intrigue and plenty of attacking intent. As both sides looked to solidify their standing in the league, the match unfolded into a rollercoaster of momentum shifts and individual brilliance. Early Advantage and Unfortunate Setbacks The match, held on May 3rd, 2026 , began with a surge of energy from the home side. AZ Alkmaar took the initiative early, looking to dominate possession and pin Twente back into their own half. The pressure paid off in the 13th minute when Jordy Clasie picked up the ball outside the penalty area and unleashed a powerful right-footed strike. The ball flew past the keeper to give AZ an early advantage, setting a frantic tempo for the opening period. However, the lead was erased in unfortunate circumstances just after the half-hour mark. In the 32nd minute, a defensive mishap saw goalkeeper Rome Owusu-Oduro inadvertently turn the ball into his own net, gifting Twente an equalizer and swinging the momentum toward the visitors before the halftime whistle. Twente Seize the Lead in the Second Half The second half saw Twente emerge with renewed confidence, exploiting the spaces left by an AZ side pushing to reclaim their lead. In the 55th minute, the turnaround was completed through a clinical attacking move. Kristian Hlynsson turned provider, finding Sam Lammers in a dangerous position; Lammers made no mistake, using his left foot to slot the ball home and put Twente in the driving seat. AZ manager responded with a series of tactical changes, introducing Peer Koopmeiners for the goalscorer Clasie in the 60th minute, followed later by Mexx Meerdink and Bendeguz Kovacs to inject fresh energy into the final third. Despite the changes, AZ struggled to find a way through a resolute Twente defense, with Troy Parrott missing several chances as the clock ticked toward the 90-minute mark. Stoppage-Time Redemption for the Hosts Just as it appeared that Twente would escape with all three points, the match delivered one final, heart-stopping twist deep into injury time. In the 95th minute, Rome Owusu-Oduro transitioned from villain to hero, providing a long-range assist that found Peer Koopmeiners . The substitute took aim from outside the box and struck a magnificent right-footed shot that beat the keeper, sparking wild celebrations in the stands. It was a moment of pure redemption for the young goalkeeper and a testament to AZ Alkmaar 's persistence. The referee blew the final whistle shortly after, concluding a thrilling 2-2 draw where neither side refused to back down until the very last second.

A High-Stakes Clash in the Eredivisie On May 17, 2026, the stadium hosted an electric Eredivisie encounter as PSV Eindhoven squared off against Twente in front of 35,400 passionate fans. Both sides approached the match with clear tactical intent, setting the stage for a compelling display of competitive football. The Opening Half PSV Eindhoven started with purpose and drew first blood in the 15th minute when Ryan Flamingo headed home a delivery from Ivan Perisic . The visitors were quick to respond, however, as Sondre Oerjasaeter leveled the score just one minute later, assisted by Daouda Weidmann . The game remained end-to-end until the 44th minute, when Noah Fernandez restored the home side's lead with a brilliant strike from outside the box, sending the teams into the break with a narrow margin. Second Half Dominance and Finality Following the interval, the momentum stayed with the home side as they looked to cement their authority. In the 53rd minute, Dennis Man fired in a left-footed effort, and shortly after, in the 56th minute, Guus Til doubled the lead with an impressive strike from outside the penalty area. Despite persistent efforts from Twente to claw their way back, PSV Eindhoven remained composed. The victory was effectively sealed in the 84th minute when Ricardo Pepi stepped up to convert a penalty after Anass Salah-Eddine was brought down, capping off a deserved win as the final whistle blew.
